## 2025-06-04 - Enhanced OpenAPI Documentation
**Learning:** For backend-only API repositories without a frontend UI, Developer Experience (DX) improvements directly impact UX. Enhancing auto-generated OpenAPI/Swagger documentation metadata by adding logical endpoint grouping (tags) and app descriptions makes the API much easier to consume.
**Action:** Always verify if FastAPI applications are missing descriptions, versions, or endpoint tags and add them to improve the Swagger UI DX.
